campaign.brief: Safi Collective 1 is introducing its fictional kitchen appliance to US, RW, SN audiences. The campaign aims to encourage product trials among people interested in quick recipes, beverage culture. Create 2 carousel deliverables for instagram using a practical before-and-after walkthrough. The work should feel sensory and instructional, show a credible use case, and communicate transparent sponsorship. The key message is that the product supports a specific everyday need without exaggerated claims. Invite viewers to start a free trial. Content must be in en; rw, fr is preferred. Success will be reviewed using video completion rate. The fee includes concepting, production, one revision, and 30 days of organic usage. Paid usage or category exclusivity requires the stated multiplier.
